title: ACS SessionContext
description: Portable container schema for a Guardian Agent's per-session state (Specification 8). Standardizes session_id, chain_hash, entries, provenance_summary, and optional intent for audit export, archival, and cross-Guardian verification while leaving additionalProperties open so Guardians can attach implementation-specific runtime state.

chain_hash.description: Rolling lowercase-hex SHA-256 head of the session's ContextEntry audit chain (Specification 8.2 and 8.6).

entries.description: Append-only sequence of ContextEntry records in the session's audit chain.

provenance_summary.description: Cumulative session-level provenance summary across entries observed in the session (Specification 8.3).

intent.description: Optional canonical session Intent established at sessionStart or the first agentTrigger and extended only via ASK intent_extension grants (Specification 8.4 and 9.1).
